-----Original Message-----
From: Evans, Josh

Subject: FW: Remapping Interest Capitalisation

fyi

-----Original Message-----
From: Evans, Josh
Sent: Thursday, September 19, 2024 10:40 AM
To: Perkins, Jonathan; Robertson, Gemma
Cc: Walters Jr., Paul; Smith, Ryan; Marshall, Robert; Carey, Howard; Graham, Amanda; Johnson, Valerie; Hughes, Dylan; Walters, Russell; Coleman, Maurice
Subject: Remapping Interest Capitalisation

Request to remap the below two GL accounts for Interest Capitalisation equity from Cognos account 1755 (Other Sovereign Debt)
to Cognos 1690 (Other Income - Other)               Effective: for SEPTEMBER 2024 Close.

     GL Accounts      Description                             From: Current Mapping              To: New Mapping
          78892830     Interest Cap Equity Settlement         1755_78892830                     1690_78892830
          60765877     Interest Cap Equity                         1755_60765877                     1690_60765877


Interest Capitalisation equity (GL accounts 78892830-Interest Cap equity settlement and 60765877-Interest Cap equity) map to Westgate Finance 1755-interest capitalised. The only entities using these two GL accounts as of July and the YTD credit balances in each of them are entities 141-£426,324, 179-£262,616, 413-£10,145 (debit), 536-£2,453,126, 60-£73,113 and 62-£232,350.

In conclusion I have reviewed the proposed remapping with representatives of the various Corporate Lending entities and they confirmed the remapping would not present any problems to them.

PS. Pls notify me or Maurice Coleman when change is made in Manchester so he can remap same accounts in EOC Cognos.
</quoted>
